sloka: न ज्ञातित्वं न सौहार्दं न जातिस्तव दुर्मते।प्रमाणं न च सौदर्यं न धर्मो धर्मदूषण ।। ६.८७.१२ ।।
transliteration: na jñātitvaṁ na sauhārdaṁ na jātistava durmate।pramāṇaṁ na ca saudaryaṁ na dharmo dharmadūṣaṇa ।। 6.87.12 ।।

translations.english: "Evil minded Vibheeshana! You are vitiating righteousness, have no value to your race, no affection to your clan, no brotherly feeling and have no righteousness."
